Product Sales Data Cleaning & MIS Dashboard

View on GitHub ↗

Excel · SUMIFS/COUNTIFS/AVERAGEIFS · PivotTables · No code

  • Took a raw, messy 1,502-row sales export and cleaned it into a validated 1,500-row dataset — fixing 2 duplicate records and reducing 378 null cells to 8 (97.9% reduction) using formula-driven checks, not manual edits.
  • Rebuilt the discount waterfall (Quantity × UnitPrice × (1 − Discount)) and cross-validated it against the source TotalPrice column for all 1,500 rows to confirm the raw figures were trustworthy.
  • Built a one-page, formula-linked MIS dashboard (no hardcoded values) with KPI cards, region/product/salesperson breakdowns, and a monthly trend line, backed by SUMIFS/COUNTIFS/AVERAGEIFS summary sheets that recalculate automatically.
  • Logged known data-quality limitations openly (5 unresolved region-casing entries, 8 remaining nulls) instead of masking them — the same discipline a live MIS reporting pipeline requires.
